items.narrative: Cache eviction strategy reconsidered and changed from LFU to LRU with a 300-second TTL. LRU with TTL combines two mechanisms: eviction of least-recently-used entries when cache reaches capacity, and automatic expiration of all entries after 300 seconds regardless of access patterns. This approach provides more predictable behavior and simpler operational semantics than frequency-based eviction alone.
